```{r}
#| label: read-in-data

file_path_header <- "~/Downloads/datafest2026/Clean-Data"

departments <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "departments.csv")) |>
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county), department_name = str_to_title(department_name))
determinants <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "determinants.csv"))
diagnosis <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "diagnosis.csv"))
encounters <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "encounters.csv"))
patients <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "patients.csv"))
providers <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "providers.csv")) |> 
  mutate(office_address = str_replace(office_address, "CT", "Ct"))
tigercensus <- read_csv(file.path(file_path_header, "tigercensus.csv"))
```



```{r}
#| label: get-ks-shapefile
#| cache: true

kansas_county <- counties(state = "KS", year = 2024, progress_bar = FALSE) |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

kansas_tract <- tracts(state = "KS", year = 2024, progress_bar = FALSE) |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

#kansas_zip <- zctas(state = "KS", year = 2010, progress_bar = FALSE) |> 
#  janitor::clean_names()
```

```{r}
#| label: mutate-props-virtual-data

#so postal_code = zip_code

#proposed viz: map of kansas, specifically northeast if possible
#county lines, plot a point for each SVH location, then shade each county by the number of virtual visits and in person visits - might have to be more granular tbh because it's lowkey too granular

#departments has tract variable
encounters_patients <- left_join(encounters, patients,
  by = join_by(patient_durable_key == durable_key)) |>
  mutate(is_virtual_visit = str_detect(visit_type_description, "Virtual"), 
         .before = is_ed_visit) |>
  left_join(departments, by = join_by(department_key))

virtual_visit_tract <- encounters_patients |>
  group_by(census_tract) |>
  drop_na(census_tract) |>
  summarize(pct_visit_tract = mean(is_virtual_visit, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(census_tract = as.character(census_tract))

virtual_visit_county <- encounters_patients |>
  mutate(county_code = substr(census_tract, 3, 5)) |>
  group_by(county_code) |>
  summarize(pct_visit_county = mean(is_virtual_visit, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  drop_na(county_code)

kansas_tract_virtual <- kansas_tract |>
  left_join(virtual_visit_tract, by = join_by(geoid == census_tract), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  left_join(virtual_visit_county, by = join_by(countyfp == county_code), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  filter(countyfp %in% virtual_visit_county$county_code)

kansas_county_virtual <- kansas_county |> 
  filter(countyfp %in% virtual_visit_county$county_code) |>
  left_join(virtual_visit_county, by = join_by(countyfp == county_code), relationship = "many-to-one")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-tract-version

  ggplot() +
  #graph tracts with aes(fill) prop of virtual visits
  geom_sf(data = kansas_tract_virtual, aes(fill = pct_visit_tract)) +
  #graph points of hospitals
  geom_sf(data = kansas_county_virtual, fill = NA, aes(color = pct_visit_county), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() #+
```
